thread:
Maria Chen: incident-bot paged me — Horizon (customer:vpc-horizon) seeing funcall failures in prod since ~08:20 UTC. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: SEV-2: tool/function-calling errors for tenant vpc-horizon. 35% error rate 08:20-08:35. Recent logs attached to incident.
Aj Patel: on it. what's the error signature?
Maria Chen: logs show parser rejects returned tool payload when it contains certain escape sequences, e.g. "\u2028" and poorly escaped newlines. stacktrace snippet below:
Maria Chen: ```
2026-03-15T08:22:04Z ERROR funcall_parser: unexpected token at position 14
payload: {"result":"Line1\\u000aLine2"}
error: JSON::ParserError at funcall_handler.rb:142
```
Samir Gupta: hmm, looks like the tool/channel is serializing strings with literal escape codes rather than proper JSON escaping. could be a regression from the tool-side serializer or a change in our parser's strictness.
Elaine Wu: customer is on a dedicated pool (dedicated-gpu-12) and VPC routing. tenant isolation should prevent blast radius but the customer flow is failing. Do we have a quick mitigation?
Aj Patel: quick mitigation options: 1) enable permissive fallback parser (less strict) for tenant vpc-horizon; 2) route their requests to a compatible model variant that doesn't invoke the failing tool; 3) apply a transient shim that post-processes tool outputs to normalize escapes.
Maria Chen: can we toggle the permissive parser at runtime for just that tenant?
Samir Gupta: yes. config flag path: `serving.parsers.funcall.strict_json` is per-tenant overrideable. I'll check if we have recent changes to that flag.
Samir Gupta: checking git history... found commit 7c3a8f that tightened parser behavior last week and defaulted permissive->false. That commit was rolled to staging then prod on 2026-03-14. Could explain timing.
Aj Patel: OK, prioritize minimal-risk fix. Samir — can you flip permissive parser ON for vpc-horizon and monitor? Maria — please notify Horizon support and include ETA ~10m. Elaine — coordinate with Dedicated infra to ensure routing change safe.
Samir Gupta: running patch now. command: ```
redwoodctl config set --tenant vpc-horizon serving.parsers.funcall.strict_json=false --session incident-2187654321
```
deploy-bot: config-change queued: change-id cfg-9921 by samir. estimated rollout 00:02:30
Samir Gupta: rollout started. tailing logs and error rate now.
Maria Chen: pinged Horizon with a short note: "seeing funcall errors, applying transient workaround. will update in 15m."
Samir Gupta: update: after flip, error rate dropped from 35% -> 4% in 90s. stacktraces no longer appearing. Monitoring: latency +10ms typical.
Aj Patel: great. we should still investigate root cause with the tool team — either their serializer changed or our strictness clipped valid but oddly-escaped payloads. Samir, please capture sample failing payloads and upload to the incident ticket.
Samir Gupta: done. uploaded /incidents/2187654321/artifacts/sample-fails.log
Elaine Wu: liaising with Dedicated infra — they confirm tenant routing unaffected and isolation preserved. no signs of cross-tenant impact.
Maria Chen: handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. Aj — can you own the incident until Samir completes the postmortem? I'll update oncall rotation.
Aj Patel: taking over. I'll keep the permissive parser live for now while we validate a safer fix (parser shim or tool-side patch).
incident-bot: NOTE: on-call handoff recorded. previous_oncall: Maria Chen, new_oncall: Aj Patel.
Samir Gupta: plan for next steps: 1) reproduce locally with failing serializer; 2) implement a small normalization shim in the funcall plumbing (escape-normalize) and add unit tests; 3) recommend tool author to fix serializer. target: repro + PR within 48h.
Maria Chen: thanks team. I'll mark incident channel with customer impact note and link to SRE runbook. final status for now: mitigated (workaround applied), customer experiencing degraded but functional behavior, dedicated pool unaffected.
Aj Patel: filing follow-up ticket for regression rollback discussion with release team. tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml for visibility. :eyes:
Maria Chen: closing slack thread for live updates; will reopen if error rate climbs back above 10%.
